# Search vector indexes dotted-name segments

The entities.search_vector generated column must include dotted-name segments by building a tsvector from coalesced name, a version of name with '.' replaced by ' ', and payload::text (i.e. to_tsvector('english', coalesce(name, '') || ' ' || replace(coalesce(name, ''), '.', ' ') || ' ' || coalesce(payload::text, ''))).

Allow full-text searches to match subcomponents of dotted names (for example, so searching for 'mod' will match 'pkg.mod').
